units.source_text: “再说，同时我还有一个相好的女子。

en.t: Besides, at the same time I had another woman I was fond of.

units.source_text: 这女子人品很好，心地也诚实，看来很有意思。

en.t: This woman had a very good character, an honest heart, and seemed quite charming.

units.source_text: 诗歌也会作，字也会写，琴也会弹，手很妙，口齿伶俐，处处可以看出来。

en.t: She could compose poems, write beautifully, and play the koto; her hands were skillful, her speech was clever, and these talents showed in everything she did.
Her looks were also quite acceptable.

units.source_text: 我把那嫉妒女子家里作为经常的宿处，有时偶尔悄悄地到这个女子家里去过夜，觉得很可留恋。

en.t: I made the jealous woman's house my regular lodging, but now and then I would secretly spend the night at this woman's house, and I found it hard to leave.

units.source_text: 那嫉妒女子死后，我一时茫然若失，悲哀痛惜，觉得也是枉然，便常常亲近这女子。

en.t: After that jealous woman died, I felt lost for a time and grieved bitterly, but realizing that sorrow was useless, I often drew close to this woman.

units.source_text: 日子一久，就发见这个人略有浮华轻薄之处，教人看不惯。

en.t: As time went on, I discovered that she had a somewhat frivolous and shallow side, which became hard to tolerate.

units.source_text: 我觉得靠不住，就逐渐疏远她。

en.t: I felt she could not be relied upon, so I gradually distanced myself from her.

units.source_text: 这期间她似乎另有了情夫。

en.t: During that time, she apparently took another lover.
